repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The IR requires a 1-minute sustain window (60,000 ms). The candidate used a 1000 ms wrapper period with a threshold of 60 ticks, resulting in a 60-second window. Additionally, the IR does not contain a `break`, causing the candidate to terminate prematurely instead of completing the one-shot sequence. Evidence F1 shows the condition held for 59 seconds before the IR action fired at 60,000 ms, while F2 shows the candidate fired at 59,000 ms.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed `period` to 100 ms to match the sustain granularity. Updated the tick threshold from 60 to 601 (duration/period + 1) to ensure the action fires exactly at 60,000 ms. Removed the `break` statement as the IR is a one-shot sequence without an explicit termination condition.
